scenes.title: Cars for everyone
scenes.text: In 1908, Ford launched the Model T. By 1927, over fifteen million were built, changing travel forever.

scenes.title: The first message
scenes.text: In 1969, scientists sent the first message between two computers. ARPANET crashed after two letters: L O.

scenes.title: The first email
scenes.text: In 1971, Ray Tomlinson sent the first network email, and picked the at sign for addresses.

scenes.title: First handheld call
scenes.text: In 1973, Martin Cooper made the first handheld phone call. His phone weighed a kilogram.

scenes.title: The World Wide Web
scenes.text: In 1991, Tim Berners-Lee opened the first website. The web made the internet easy for everyone.

scenes.title: Social media
scenes.text: Then social media took off. Facebook arrived in 2004, YouTube in 2005, and Twitter in 2006. Suddenly, everyone had an audience.

scenes.title: Internet in your pocket
scenes.text: In 2007, the iPhone put the internet in every pocket. Apps and streaming followed quickly.

scenes.title: What comes next?
scenes.text: Today, satellites and AI are changing everything. Six billion people are online. What comes next?
